ZH-UX-01-001.notes: 就是了 at the end of a sentence closes the matter reassuringly: just do X and that's that. 你放心就是了 tells the listener there's nothing to worry about.

ZH-UX-01-002.notes: 别说了 drops the subject, opened by 算了 (forget it, let it go). It can stand alone or open a sentence, and can sound dismissive or resigned.

ZH-UX-01-003.notes: Rhetorical 哪儿 + 有 denies outright: where would I get money from = I have none. 啊 at the end adds exasperation.

ZH-UX-01-004.notes: Adjective + 什么 rejects someone's evaluation: 好什么 = good? hardly! The same works with verbs: 哭什么 (what are you crying for?).

ZH-UX-01-005.notes: 他会来…呢 is ironically denied by 才怪 (it'd be a miracle), always sentence-final. The speaker is sure he won't come.

ZH-UX-01-006.notes: 怪 + adjective + 的 = rather, quite, a mild northern intensifier. The closing 的 is part of the pattern.

ZH-UX-01-007.notes: 老 before a verb = keep (doing), always, typically in a complaint. 怎么老… is a reproachful question; 总是 is the neutral equivalent.
ZH-UX-01-007.tr: Why do you keep forgetting your keys?
ZH-UX-01-007.flag: dup: replaced 他老迟到 (same as HSK3-08-011 他总是迟到)

ZH-UX-01-008.notes: 够 + adjective (+ 了) = adjective enough; it precedes the adjective, unlike English. 够大了 = big enough already.

ZH-UX-01-009.notes: 时间 is the topic and 别着急 the advice, so the predicate is 有的是 (there's plenty of). Note the stress differs from 有的 'some'.

ZH-UX-01-010.notes: 明天七点 sets a meeting time, sealed with the formula 不见不散 (we won't leave until we've met). It commits both sides to wait.

ZH-UX-01-011.notes: In speech, 一 is often dropped between a verb and a measure word: 买个包 = 买一个包. It only works after a verb, not at the start of a sentence.

ZH-UX-01-012.notes: 蛮 + adjective = quite, rather, typical of Wu (Shanghai), Xiang and other southern varieties; northern speakers say 挺…的. The closing 的 is common.

ZH-UX-01-013.notes: 超 + adjective = super, an informal intensifier spread by online and youth speech across the Chinese-speaking world. It's out of place in writing.

ZH-UX-01-014.notes: 好 + adjective as an exclamation (好开心, 好漂亮) = so…, strongly associated with Taiwan and the south, now widespread in mainland speech too. It's different from neutral 很.

ZH-UX-02-001.notes: A habit in the past takes no 了: 常常去, not 常常去了. 了 marks a bounded event, which is incompatible with 常常 or 每天.

ZH-UX-02-002.notes: 学 is the attempt, 学会 the success: three years of study without mastery is 还没学会. The negative of a result complement uses 没 and drops 了.
ZH-UX-02-002.text: 我学了三年钢琴，可是还没{{c1::学会::learn (and succeed)}}。
ZH-UX-02-002.tr: I studied the piano for three years and still can't play.
ZH-UX-02-002.flag: dup: replaced 我学会了开车 (flagged against HSK3-02-006 我学会游泳了)

ZH-UX-02-003.notes: 听 is the attempt and 听见 the result: listening for ages need not mean hearing. English 'listen' / 'hear' map neatly onto the pair.

ZH-UX-02-004.notes: 没 + result in the second clause contrasts with the attempt in the first: 找 (look for) vs 找到 (find). English 'couldn't find' is 没找到, not 不能找.

ZH-UX-02-005.notes: 帮 takes a person object and a verb: 帮你拿行李. 帮忙 is verb + object and can't take another object: 帮忙你 is wrong; say 帮你的忙.
ZH-UX-02-005.tip: 帮忙你 is a common error: use 帮你 or 帮你的忙.
ZH-UX-02-005.tr: Let me help you with your bags.
ZH-UX-02-005.flag: dup: replaced 你能帮我吗 (flagged against HSK2-07-004)

ZH-UX-02-006.notes: 结婚 is intransitive: the spouse comes in with 跟 or 和 (跟她结婚). 结婚她 is a classic error from English 'marry her'.

ZH-UX-02-007.notes: 感兴趣 takes its topic with 对: 对历史感兴趣. 我感兴趣历史 is wrong; 我对…很感兴趣 is the full pattern, with 很 before 感兴趣.

ZH-UX-02-008.notes: Degree adverbs go before the verb: 非常喜欢, never 喜欢…非常. English 'very much' at the end has to move forward.

ZH-UX-02-009.notes: Happy for someone = 为 + person + 高兴, with 为 (wèi) marking the beneficiary. 对你高兴 is a calque from English and wrong.

ZH-UX-02-010.notes: Good for = 对 + beneficiary + 有好处 / 好. 为孩子有好处 is a common error: 为 marks someone you act for, not who benefits from a thing.
ZH-UX-02-010.text: 早睡早起{{c1::对::for (good for: … 孩子有好处)}}孩子有好处。
ZH-UX-02-010.tr: Early nights and early mornings are good for children.
ZH-UX-02-010.flag: dup: replaced 多运动对身体好 (near-identical to HSK2-09-010)

ZH-UX-02-011.notes: 还 + 要 = want another, more: 我还要一杯. English 'another' isn't 另一杯 in this context; 另 implies a different one.

ZH-UX-02-012.notes: With a non-round number plus a measure word, 多 follows the measure word: 两个多小时 (over two hours). Putting it before (两多个小时) is wrong.
ZH-UX-02-012.text: 开会开了两个{{c1::多::over (两个 … 小时)}}小时。
ZH-UX-02-012.tr: The meeting went on for over two hours.
ZH-UX-02-012.flag: dup: replaced 我等了一个多小时 (near-identical to HSK2-11-012)

ZH-UX-02-013.notes: With a round number (十, 三百), 多 goes before the measure word: 三百多页. 三百页多 would put it in the wrong slot.
ZH-UX-02-013.text: 这本书三百{{c1::多::over (三百 … 页)}}页。
ZH-UX-02-013.tr: This book is over 300 pages long.
ZH-UX-02-013.flag: dup: replaced 来了十多个人 (near-identical to HSK2-11-015 来了十几个人)

ZH-UX-02-014.notes: Time words go before the verb, never at the end as in English: 我明天去北京, not 我去北京明天. They can also open the sentence: 明天我去北京.

ZH-UX-02-015.notes: Place phrases with 在 go before the verb: 在家吃饭, not 吃饭在家. Only verbs of position (住, 坐, 放) also allow 在 after them.

ZH-UX-02-016.notes: 再 (again) and 在 (at; -ing) are both zài, so they're often confused in writing. A repeat visit still to happen is 再.

ZH-UX-02-017.notes: 和 joins nouns, not clauses: 我吃了饭，和看了电视 is wrong. Sequential actions need 然后, 再 or 又, or just a comma.

ZH-UX-02-018.notes: A question word (哪儿) already makes the question, so 吗 is impossible; 呢 can soften it. 你周末去哪儿吗? would be wrong.
